insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
plan_name: Star Cancer Care Platinum Insurance Policy

room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies on associated medical expenses if higher room chosen; no differential billing hospitals exempt

icu.note: ICU charges covered as part of sum insured; no specific ICU sub-limit mentioned beyond room rent proportionality

copayment.note: 10% co-payment on each and every claim for insured persons whose age at entry is 61 years and above; applies to fresh and renewal policies

sub_limits.display: Cataract, pain mgmt, modern treatments, hospice, post-hosp, rehab capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹30k-₹40k/eye; Post-hosp: 2% of SI per hospitalisation; Rehab/Pain mgmt: up to 10% of SI; Hospice: 20% of SI lifetime; Modern treatments: procedure-wise sub-limits; Oral chemo/immunotherapy: up to 50% of SI

ped_waiting.note: Includes cancer as PED; reducible via portability/migration credit

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions include cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacements, gallbladder, kidney calculi, gynaec diseases, prostate, varicose veins, transplants, congenital internal diseases, and others

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Code Excl 18)

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% of basic SI per claim-free year; max 50% of basic SI; reduced proportionately on claims

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

post_hosp.note: Capped at 2% of basic sum insured per hospitalisation

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to sum insured; Yoga/Naturopathy subject to prior company approval

organ_donor.note: No organ donor expense benefit mentioned; transplant surgeries are under 24-month specific disease waiting period

ambulance.note: Emergency road ambulance covered when medically necessary and there is an admissible claim; no rupee cap stated

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, deep brain stimulation, oral chemo (up to 50% SI), immunotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, HIFU, balloon sinuplasty, stem cell therapy, IONM, vaporisation of prostate covered with procedure-wise sub-limits per policy period

consumables.note: Consumables are listed as items subsumed into room/procedure charges but not separately covered as a benefit; no consumables rider offered

global_cover.note: Territorial limit: all treatments must be taken in India

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to first policy SI; enhanced SI has separate 60-month count

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly instalment; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines; accrued waiting period credits transferable

notable_exclusions.display: Circumcision, congenital external defects, convalescence, EECP/chelation/hyperbaric O2, PRP injections, biologicals (outpatient), vaccination, spectacles/hearing aids

optional_riders.display: Lump-sum cancer benefit for recurrence/metastasis/second malignancy (30mo wait; 50% of SI)
optional_riders.note: Section II optional cover; lump sum = 50% of basic SI; ceases after one claim
